Setting Up Your myID

Before You Begin

To set up your myID, you will need:

  • A smart device (the myID app works on most smartphones and is available via the Apple App Store or Google Play)
  • A personal email address (this must be your own — not a shared or work email)
  • To be 15 years or older (some government services may have additional requirements)
Setup Guide

How to Set Up | Step-by-Step

Follow these steps to set up your myID. Open any step to see exactly what to do.

Step 1 — Download the myID app

Download the app from the official stores below:

Only download the myID app from official app stores

Step 2 — Open the app and get started
  • Open the myID app on your device
  • If this is your first time, select “Set up myID”
  • If you already have an account, select “I am an existing user” and follow the prompts
Step 3 — Enter your email address
  • Enter your personal email address
  • This should be an email you will always have access to
  • Example: james.wilson@email.com
Step 4 — Create your password
  • Enter a secure password
  • Confirm it in the second field
Step 5 – Enter your personal details
  • Provide the following details:
    • Given name
    • Family name
    • Date of birth
  • Ensure these match your official identity documents exactly
Step 6 – Set your identity strength
  • You will now be asked to set your identity strength.
  • By default, you will have Basic identity strength.
  • To proceed, select: “Increase identity strength”
Step 7 – Choose your identity level
  • You will need to increase your identity strength to:
  • Standard – suitable for most individuals
  • Strong – required for business owners or directors acting as a principal authority
    • Select the + icons to add your identity documents
    • Follow the prompts to verify each document
  • For Strong identity strength, you will need:
    • A valid Australian passport, or one expired within the last 3 years
Step 8 – Identity strength updated
  • Once your identity documents are verified:
    • Your identity strength will update to Standard or Strong
    • Your myID is now ready to use
  • Note: If you cannot reach Strong identity strength
  • Please contact the myID support line:
  • Within Australia: 1300 287 539
  • Select Option 2, then Option
  • If you are overseas: +61 2 6216 1111
  • Ask to be transferred to the myID support line
  • Operating hours:
  • 8:00 am to 6:00 pm (local Australian time), Monday to Friday
  • Overseas support: 8:00 am to 6:00 pm AEDT, Monday to Friday
